Start the loopback HTTP authentication gate.

Source: R/curation_auth_http.R
curation_auth_http_gate.Rd

The gate exposes only the login/logout form, an nginx auth_request validity endpoint, and a minimal health endpoint. It never proxies the Shiny application. The default routes are rooted at /app/; deployment runners may pass explicit /auth/* and /healthz routes while keeping the protected app prefix and cookie policy unchanged.

Usage

curation_auth_http_gate(
  auth,
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 43925L,
  expected_origin = NULL,
  app_path = "/app/",
  cookie_name = "biogain_session",
  blocking = TRUE,
  login_path = NULL,
  public_login_path = NULL,
  check_path = NULL,
  logout_path = NULL,
  public_logout_path = NULL,
  health_path = NULL,
  public_origin = NULL,
  trusted_proxy_header = NULL,
  trusted_proxy_value = "1",
  max_body_bytes = 8192L,
  cookie_max_age = 43200L,
  login_title = "Curation login",
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

auth

A store from curation_auth_open().

host

Listener host. Only 127.0.0.1 is accepted.

port

Unprivileged listener port.

expected_origin

Exact public HTTPS origin.

app_path

Canonical protected application prefix, ending in /.

cookie_name

Opaque session-cookie name.

blocking

Keep servicing the server until interrupted. Native service runners should use the default; tests can set FALSE and call $stop().

login_path

Optional internal login-handler route override. The browser-visible form action is public_login_path.

public_login_path

Browser-visible login route, normally /app/login.

check_path

Optional internal auth-request route override.

logout_path

Optional internal logout-handler route override.

public_logout_path

Browser-visible logout route, normally /app/logout.

health_path

Optional health route override.

public_origin

Backward-compatible alias for expected_origin.

trusted_proxy_header

Optional exact header nginx sets on internal auth subrequests. The loopback deployment also requires forwarded URI, method, HTTPS, and (for mutations) original origin metadata.

trusted_proxy_value

Required value for trusted_proxy_header.

max_body_bytes

Maximum login form body size.

cookie_max_age

Cookie lifetime in seconds.

login_title

Plain-text heading for the login form. Defaults to the generic Curation login; project deployment runners may supply branding.

quiet

Suppress httpuv startup diagnostics.

...

Reserved for deployment-runner compatibility; route and origin options should be supplied through their named arguments.

Value

An object with stop(), server, and config when blocking is FALSE; a stopped object invisibly after an interrupt otherwise.
